interpretation: Exhaustive only across this published finite applicable grid; not every mathematically possible real-valued parameter. Every accepted grid expansion requires a versioned amendment before running that grid.
candidate_cartesian_product: Each of 52 families × 6 selector modes = 312 candidate hypotheses; each candidate expands only dimensions listed by its parameter_group. BASELINE candidates must not depend on feature thresholds.

cost_model.statutory_charges: calculate from effective date and current applicable NSE schedule; reuse the project's validated cost implementation; changes require a versioned model
cost_model.option_slippage: existing project convention: adverse ₹0.05 per option leg per fill in base case where source model assumes LTP; add bid/ask-aware replay where raw quotes exist
cost_model.brokerage_sensitivity_note: Primary conservative scenario is ₹20 per executed order, reflecting Paytm Money's 18-Dec-2024 official notice effective 15-Jan-2025. ₹10/order retained only as a legacy-plan sensitivity because Paytm Money's current F&O FAQ also lists ₹10; account-specific tariff must be confirmed before deployment.
cost_model.no_double_counting: Brokerage rates are separate scenarios (₹20 primary, ₹10 legacy sensitivity). Slippage stress changes adverse execution slippage only; statutory levies remain fixed under that stress.

search_control.shard_order: candidate_id ascending then lexicographic parameter-product order

family_geometry_policy.rule: A family must have an explicit, validated leg template before numerical replay. Preset names and small payoff thumbnails alone are insufficient for ambiguous multi-leg structures. When exact legs cannot be reconstructed, test a clearly named standard variant or mark the source variant SPECIFICATION_BLOCKED; do not silently guess.

amendments.reason: Registry contained 52 distinct structure families rather than the planned 50. Retain all 52 (312 structure × selector hypotheses) and limit every dimension to a published, reproducible coarse grid before any numerical replay. Cost scenarios are evaluated side-by-side for each configuration, not exploded as separate parameter configurations.
amendments.effect: No backtest results existed at amendment time. Every combination of the resulting finite per-family grid remains in scope; later refinements require a further versioned amendment.

amendments.reason: Pre-test feasibility check found grid v1.1 would require approximately 197.8 million finite configurations, making a 10,000-config/day queue take nearly 20,000 days before any replay; this did not depend on P&L because no replay had run.
amendments.effect: Reduced the coarse finite domains and the default shard size before numerical testing. All combinations of the v1.2 applicable grid remain in scope. Cost scenarios remain side-by-side outputs, not tuning dimensions. Any further grid change requires a logged new version.

amendments.reason: Pre-test sizing showed the v1.2 grid still contains 36,008,064 configurations, equivalent to about 1,441 daily 25k enumeration shards before any replay. Quote-age and minimum-OI thresholds are data eligibility gates rather than strategy-alpha parameters, and redundant expiry-pair combinations were narrowed.
amendments.effect: DTE grid reduced to expiry-day and one-week horizon; calendar pairing grid restricted to two valid listed-expiry pairings; stale-quote and min-OI filters are frozen execution/data gates, not optimizable axes. This was done before any backtest results. Every combination in the v1.3 applicable finite grid remains in scope.

execution_eligibility.derived_value_timestamp_match: exact timestamp and same strike/expiry; otherwise unavailable
execution_eligibility.spread_gate: liquidity_max_spread_pct remains an explicit finite strategy/execution configuration dimension
execution_eligibility.stale_quote_policy: no trade; never forward-fill or interpolate tradable option prices

execution_semantics.event_universe: Pinned option-expiry files; target expiry date defines split; entry calendar date is expiry minus configured 0 or 7 days; no rolling holidays/weekends.
execution_semantics.entry_policy: Exact 09:45 or 13:00 IST option/index bar timestamp only; one-minute bar OPEN used for entry; no current-bar CLOSE signal, interpolation, nearest timestamp or forward fill.
execution_semantics.minute_data_disclaimer: OHLCV(+OI) bars are not tick-level bid/ask/order-book data; 15-second quote age is not verifiable from minute bars.
execution_semantics.liquidity_max_spread_pct: Applied to 100*(high-low)/open at the exact entry bar as an intrabar-range liquidity proxy; never described as observed bid-ask spread.
execution_semantics.selector_semantics: BASELINE takes every data-eligible opportunity; other selector modes are fixed-family entry filters with abstention, not hidden strategy replacement.
execution_semantics.specification_gate: PHASE45_TEMPLATE_REQUIRES_RECONCILIATION and SPECIFICATION_BLOCKED configurations emit explicit BLOCKED_SPECIFICATION records; diagnostic-only families cannot be promoted.
execution_semantics.futures_gate: Configurations needing actual intraday traded-futures quotes/hedges are blocked unless a synchronized intraday futures feed is independently audited; daily EOD basis is only a lagged proxy.

costs.stress_interpretation: 0/50/100 means ₹0.05/₹0.075/₹0.10 adverse slippage per leg per fill; statutory charges remain fixed and date-aware under this stress.

promotion_gates.must_pass_inference: Paired block-bootstrap CI above zero and Holm-adjusted familywise p<0.05

execution_semantics.strike_selection: ATM_OFFSET: select nearest ATM from contracts present at the exact entry timestamp using exact-time NIFTY index open; derive modal strike gap from that exact-time option snapshot using Phase43 helper semantics; strike = ATM + signed offset_steps × modal_step. Never use ordinal rank or replace a missing target strike.
execution_semantics.abs_delta_selection: Use exact entry_ts minus one minute and only that prior completed option/index bar close for IV/delta; use prior-bar OI>=100 gate. Then require the same selected contract at exact entry_ts and use that bar open as the OHLC fill reference. Missing exact prior bar, IV or entry open means explicit exclusion.
execution_semantics.no_lookahead_review: 2026-10-09 code review found and corrected lookahead in the exploratory delta audit before any config-grid P&L. Prior selected-strike coverage counts are superseded pending rerun.
